_about: The kinds of furniture the agent API (/api/v2, ADR-135) and the measuring guide (/measure) know, each mapped to a configurator product (config/quote_products.json, whose ranges and defaults apply). Per size: the API name, the configurator field it fills, whether it must be given, other names an agent may use, what it means and how to measure it. A size with "requires" is asked only when that yes/no is true. Draft texts from what the configurator asks today: the owner checks and edits them here (English; other languages later through the CMS).

general.units: Sizes are in centimetres (cm). Send "unit": "mm" to give them in millimetres instead.
general.how: Measure the furniture itself, not the cover you want: we add the room a cover needs. Measure at the widest point, outside to outside, with cushions in place, to the nearest centimetre. Width is left to right as you face the furniture, depth front to back, height from the ground up.
tips: Use a tape measure held straight and level; do not follow curves.
Measure arms, back and legs where they stick out the furthest.
If your furniture stands on a slope, measure the height at the highest leg.
Rough sizes to the centimetre are enough: the cover has a few centimetres of room.

sofa.label: Sofa or lounge bench (straight)
sofa.how: A straight sofa: the cover runs from the ground at the front over the seat and the back to the ground behind.

sizes.name: width
sizes.means: Outside width, arm to arm, at the widest point.
sizes.how: Stand in front of the sofa and measure from the outside of the left arm to the outside of the right arm.

sizes.name: depth
sizes.how: From the front of the seat (or the front of the arms, if they stick out further) to the back of the backrest.

sizes.name: height
sizes.how: From the ground to the highest point of the backrest, cushions in place.

sizes.name: front_height
sizes.means: Height at the front: the arms, or the seat when there are no arms.
sizes.how: From the ground to the top of the arms at the front; without arms, to the top of the seat cushion.

corner_sofa.label: Corner sofa (L-shape)
corner_sofa.how: An L-shaped set measured as one piece: both legs of the L from the outside corner.

sizes.name: long_side
sizes.means: The longer leg of the L, outside to outside.
sizes.how: Along the back of the longer leg, from the outside of the corner to the far end (arm included).

sizes.name: short_side
sizes.means: The shorter leg of the L, outside to outside.
sizes.how: Along the back of the shorter leg, from the outside of the corner to the far end (arm included).

sizes.name: depth
sizes.means: Depth of a leg, front to back.
sizes.how: From the front of the seat to the back of the backrest, on one leg (both legs are usually the same).

sizes.name: height
sizes.how: From the ground to the highest point of the backrest, cushions in place.

sizes.name: front_height
sizes.means: Height at the front: the arms, or the seat when there are no arms.
sizes.how: From the ground to the top of the arms at the front; without arms, to the top of the seat cushion.

corner_sofa.left_right: Which hand the L is, as the furniture maker names it (for example "corner set left"). If you are not sure, leave it out: covers of both hands are then shown and the answer says so.

chair.label: Chair or lounge chair
chair.how: One chair under its own box-shaped cover.

sizes.name: width
sizes.means: Outside width, left to right, arms included.
sizes.how: At the widest point, usually across the arms.

sizes.name: depth
sizes.how: From the front of the seat or arms to the back of the backrest or the back legs, whichever sticks out further.

sizes.name: height
sizes.how: From the ground to the top of the backrest.

side_table.label: Side table, coffee table or fire table without a burner cover
side_table.how: A small table under its own box-shaped cover.

sizes.name: width
sizes.means: The longer side of the table top.
sizes.how: Across the top; for a round table, the diameter.

sizes.name: depth
sizes.means: The shorter side of the table top.
sizes.how: Across the top at right angles to the width; for a round table, the diameter again.

sizes.name: height
sizes.how: From the ground to the top of the table.

footstool.label: Footstool, hocker or pouf
footstool.how: A footstool under its own box-shaped cover.

sizes.name: width
sizes.how: Left to right at the widest point.

sizes.name: depth
sizes.how: Front to back at the widest point.

sizes.name: height
sizes.how: From the ground to the top of the cushion.

lounger.label: Sun lounger
lounger.how: Measure the lounger lying flat. If its back cannot fold flat, say so with headrest and measure the raised back too.

sizes.name: length
sizes.how: From the far end of the head to the far end of the foot, wheels and handles included.

sizes.name: width
sizes.how: Left to right at the widest point, armrests included.

sizes.name: height
sizes.how: From the ground to the top of the mattress or the frame, whichever is higher, with the back down.

sizes.name: headrest
sizes.means: true when the back stays raised (it cannot fold flat).
sizes.how: Leave it out or false for a lounger that lies flat.

sizes.name: headrest_height
sizes.how: From the ground to the top of the raised back.

sizes.name: headrest_length
sizes.means: How far the raised back reaches along the lounger.
sizes.how: Seen from the side: from the head end to where the raised back meets the flat part.

daybed.label: Daybed
daybed.how: A daybed is covered like a flat sun lounger. A daybed with a canopy or wider than 120 cm: ask us (made to measure by hand).

sizes.name: length
sizes.how: Along the long side at the widest point.

sizes.name: width
sizes.how: Across the short side at the widest point.

sizes.name: height
sizes.how: From the ground to the top of the mattress or the back, whichever is higher.

dining_set.label: Dining set: a rectangular table with its chairs
dining_set.how: Measure the table. With chairs (the default) the cover goes over the table and the chairs pushed in; we add the room the chairs need.

sizes.name: width
sizes.means: Table length, the long side of the top.
sizes.how: Along the table top, end to end.

sizes.name: depth
sizes.means: Table width, the short side of the top.
sizes.how: Across the table top.

sizes.name: height
sizes.how: From the ground to the top of the table.

sizes.name: chairs
sizes.means: true (default): the cover goes over the table and the chairs pushed in; false: over the table alone.
sizes.how: Decide whether the chairs stay at the table under the cover.

round_dining_set.label: Round dining set: a round table with its chairs
round_dining_set.how: Measure the table. With chairs (the default) the cover goes over the table and the chairs pushed in.

sizes.name: diameter
sizes.how: Across the middle of the top, edge to edge.

sizes.name: height
sizes.how: From the ground to the top of the table.

sizes.name: chairs
sizes.means: true (default): over the table and the chairs; false: over the table alone.
sizes.how: Decide whether the chairs stay at the table under the cover.

bbq_kamado.label: Kamado (egg) barbecue in a nest
bbq_kamado.how: Measure the barbecue cold, lid closed. Our barbecue covers go on a cold barbecue only.

sizes.name: egg_diameter
sizes.how: Across the widest part of the ceramic egg.

sizes.name: closed_height
sizes.how: From the ground to the top of the chimney cap, lid closed.

sizes.name: handle_depth
sizes.means: Depth from the handle to the hinge.
sizes.how: From the front of the handle to the back of the hinge.

sizes.name: side_tables
sizes.means: true when it has side tables (shelves) that stay up.
sizes.how: Leave it out or false without side tables.

sizes.name: tables_width
sizes.how: From the outside of one side table to the outside of the other.

bbq_kamado_table.label: Kamado barbecue in a table
bbq_kamado_table.how: Measure the table and the egg in it, cold, lid closed.

sizes.name: table_length
sizes.how: Along the table top, end to end.

sizes.name: table_width
sizes.how: Across the table top.

sizes.name: table_height
sizes.how: From the ground to the table top.

sizes.name: egg_diameter
sizes.how: Across the widest part of the egg.

sizes.name: closed_height
sizes.how: From the ground to the top of the chimney cap.

bbq_gas.label: Gas barbecue with side shelves
bbq_gas.how: Measure cold, lid closed, side shelves up.

sizes.name: width
sizes.how: From the outside of one shelf to the outside of the other.

sizes.name: depth
sizes.how: From the front of the handle to the back of the hood or cart.

sizes.name: closed_height
sizes.how: From the ground to the top of the hood.

sizes.name: shelf_height
sizes.how: From the ground to the top of a side shelf.

sizes.name: hood_width
sizes.how: Across the hood (the lid) alone.

sizes.name: width
sizes.how: At the widest point, left to right.

sizes.name: depth
sizes.how: From the front of the handle to the back.

sizes.name: closed_height
sizes.how: From the ground to the top of the lid or chimney.

sizes.name: lid_length
sizes.how: Across the lid, left to right.

sizes.name: fire_width
sizes.how: Across the top at the widest point.

sizes.name: height
sizes.how: From the ground to the top.

sizes.name: square
sizes.means: true for a square or rectangular one; false (default) for a round one.
sizes.how: Look at it from above.

sizes.name: depth
sizes.how: Front to back across the top.
